```{=html}
<div class="agst-page agst-timeline-page">
  <section class="agst-section">
    <div class="agst-section-heading agst-heading-row">
      <div>
        <div><span class="agst-section-number">15</span><p class="agst-eyebrow">CONNECTED WEEKS</p></div>
        <h1>The course timeline.</h1>
      </div>
      <p>Select a week to see its two lectures, laboratory, assignment, and any scheduled assessment. Every item opens its own authoritative course page.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="agst-filter-bar" role="group" aria-label="Filter weekly course materials">
      <button class="active" data-week-filter="all">Everything</button>
      <button data-week-filter="lecture">Lectures</button>
      <button data-week-filter="lab">Labs</button>
      <button data-week-filter="assignment">Assignments</button>
      <button data-week-filter="exam">Exams</button>
    </div>

    <div class="agst-week-shell">
      <div class="agst-week-rail" id="agst-week-rail" role="list" aria-label="Weekly course modules"></div>
      <article class="agst-week-detail" id="agst-week-detail" aria-live="polite"></article>
    </div>

    <p class="agst-provisional-note"><strong>Planning note:</strong> topic labels preserve the current course map. Individual files, dates, and detailed session titles can be added as the official materials become available.</p>

    <nav class="agst-week-nav" aria-label="Course navigation">
      <a href="../">← Course overview</a>
      <a href="../lectures/">Lecture directory</a>
      <a href="../labs/">Lab directory →</a>
    </nav>
  </section>
</div>

<script src="../../../../assets/js/agst-50104.js"></script>
```
